hook: Hoot the owl shows the class around a cartoon library. Read a book's spine label, send it home to picture books, fiction or nonfiction, then shelve picture books in ABC order.
outcome: Find picture books, fiction and nonfiction in the library and use spine labels and ABC order to locate a book
sources: Book titles and authors are made up
Illustrations drawn with FLUX.1-schnell (Apache 2.0) on a local computer, edited for Curio Class
